focus: Angle 3: profiles, DSH_HOME, and repo-local configuration

label: DSH_HOME is process-wide with a ~/.dsh default; global AGENTS and shared agents roots are also resolved from process-level home variables.
Profile configuration composes bundle, profile patch, home patch, and repeatable explicit --patch overlays.
Credentials are held in DSH_HOME while tracked profile patches use credential references; keep secrets and user data outside the repo.
Documented project discovery covers AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction chains, not a repo-local DSH config directory; auto-loading is unconfirmed.
A tracked .dsh/cordis.patch.yml can be used via explicit --patch but is a project convention, not an auto-loaded DSH profile.
Pi and Hermes each declare generated, linked, and hand-authored runtime surfaces in a SYNC.md manifest; .dsh could follow that convention.
